resources.string: Lets Agent OS perceive the screen and act across your apps to carry out your intentions. The agent reads the accessibility tree, proposes one step at a time, and always asks before any high side-effect action.
What do you want to do?
Describe it, or type “open” and an app name
Enable “Agent OS” in Settings › Accessibility so the agent can act.
No model configured yet. Set a Claude login or API key to run intents.
Give the agent a credential to run intents. Everything you paste is stored encrypted on this device only, and sent only to Anthropic over TLS — never logged or shown in the agent feed.
Pick the model that runs your intents. The cheapest is the default — step up for harder, multi-app tasks. Takes effect on your next run.

Already on Claude Pro/Max? Paste a subscription token (for example, from `ant auth print-credentials --access-token`). Used when no API key is set. Note: subscription tokens are short-lived and may need re-pasting when they expire.
Saved. The agent can now run your intents.
API key + Claude login saved on this device.
An API key is saved on this device.
A Claude subscription login is saved on this device.
